import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Overview', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival Rate by Class
survival_by_class = df.groupby('pclass')['survived'].mean()
axes[0, 0].bar(survival_by_class.index, survival_by_class.values, color=['#2ecc71', '#3498db', '#e74c3c'])
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Passenger Class')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class')
axes[0, 0].set_ylim(0, 1)
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Survival Rate by Sex
survival_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['survived'].mean()
axes[0, 1].bar(survival_by_sex.index, survival_by_sex.values, color=['#e67e22', '#9b59b6'])
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Sex')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Survival Rate by Sex')
axes[0, 1].set_ylim(0, 1)
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Age Distribution
axes[0, 2].hist(df['age'].dropna(), bins=15, color='#3498db', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Age')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[0, 2].set_title('Age Distribution')
axes[0, 2].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Survival Count
survival_count = df['survived'].value_counts()
axes[1, 0].pie(survival_count.values, labels=['Not Survived', 'Survived'], 
               autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'], startangle=90)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Overall Survival Rate')

# 5. Fare Distribution by Class
for pclass in sorted(df['pclass'].unique()):
    data = df[df['pclass'] == pclass]['fare']
    axes[1, 1].hist(data, bins=20, alpha=0.6, label=f'Class {pclass}')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Fare')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Fare Distribution by Class')
axes[1, 1].legend()
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Embarked Port Distribution
embarked_counts = df['embarked'].value_counts()
axes[1, 2].bar(embarked_counts.index, embarked_counts.values, color=['#1abc9c', '#f39c12', '#8e44ad'])
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Embarkation Port')
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[1, 2].set_title('Passengers by Embarkation Port')
axes[1, 2].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
